regulation_set: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 — Chapter IX (Initial Public Offer by Small and Medium Enterprises), Regulations 227 to 280, read with Schedule VI, as last amended on 8 March 2025, together with the NSE Emerge / BSE SME issuer checklists.
note: Curated disclosure requirement registry for an SME IPO offer document. Each item is the atomic unit tracked by the Gap & Consistency Checker. 'chapters' maps the requirement onto the DRHP tree in drhp_structure.json — this is the single source of truth for chapter-to-requirement traceability. 'evidence_fields' are dotted paths into the issuer data object; coverage is COMPUTED from their presence, never asserted. Regulation references are indicative and simplified for the prototype; a production knowledge base versions these against the live SEBI ICDR text and the exchange checklists. Version R3 extends the registry using evidence from a corpus of 14 filed NSE Emerge SME DRHPs (5,619 pages, 2.6 million words): every requirement added in R3 carries a `corpus_evidence` field recording the share of real filings that contain it. Items appearing in 79-100% of filings but absent from R2 were added; nothing was added on intuition. Registry R4: the numbered regulation citations were checked against the consolidated ICDR text published by SEBI (last amended 8 March 2025). Citations that name a regulation number have been verified against that text; citations that name a Schedule VI section describe where the disclosure sits in the offer document and are not regulation numbers.

fulfilment_legend.issuer_data: Satisfied by information the issuer supplies. Coverage depends on evidence_fields being present.
fulfilment_legend.standard_clause: Satisfied structurally by standard offer-document text that Drafter generates, with issuer fields merged in. Always flagged for merchant-banker finalisation.
fulfilment_legend.banker_certification: Can only be discharged by the merchant banker / auditor as part of due diligence and certification. Reported separately so it does not misrepresent the promoter's own progress.
fulfilment_legend.not_applicable: Some requirements are sector-conditional. Where the issuer indicates the requirement does not apply (for example installed capacity for a services business), it is reported as 'Not applicable' and excluded from the coverage denominator entirely — it is not an obligation that can be met or missed.

requirements.requirement: Name, CIN, date and place of incorporation, registered and corporate office address
requirements.source: Companies Act 2013 s.7; ICDR Sch VI (SME) Part A
requirements.evidence: Certificate of Incorporation, MOA/AOA

requirements.requirement: Main objects as set out in the Memorandum of Association
requirements.evidence: MOA objects clause

requirements.requirement: Particulars of the lead manager, registrar, market maker, banker to the issue and underwriter
requirements.evidence: Issue engagement letters, due diligence certificate

requirements.requirement: Company Secretary and Compliance Officer details, investor grievance contact
requirements.evidence: Board resolution appointing the Compliance Officer

requirements.requirement: Description of the business, products/services offered, and the revenue model
requirements.evidence: Intake Step 'Business Overview'

requirements.requirement: Industry overview and the issuer's competitive position within it
requirements.evidence: Industry data with cited public sources

requirements.requirement: Customer concentration — identity of key customers and the revenue share attributable to each
requirements.evidence: Customer-wise revenue schedule certified by the auditor

requirements.requirement: Revenue from operations stated in the business section must reconcile with the restated audited financial statements
requirements.source: ICDR consistency principle; exchange return pattern (unreconciled figures)
requirements.evidence: Cross-check: Our Business vs Restated Financial Statements

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Figures quoted in the business section not reconciling with the restated financial statements is among the most frequent causes of an exchange observation letter.

requirements.requirement: Installed capacity, capacity utilisation and principal properties/plants
requirements.evidence: Plant records, factory licences

applicability.reason: Not applicable: the issuer has indicated it does not operate manufacturing facilities. Installed capacity and utilisation are disclosures specific to manufacturing issuers.

requirements.corpus_evidence: Appears in 64% of the 14-document corpus; the balance are services issuers with no manufacturing operations, which is why this requirement is sector-conditional.

requirements.requirement: Employee strength and human resources
requirements.evidence: Payroll/HR records

requirements.requirement: Intellectual property owned or used by the issuer — trademarks, patents, designs and their registration status
requirements.evidence: Trademark/patent registration certificates and applications

requirements.requirement: Immovable properties owned or leased by the issuer, with tenure and the nature of the interest held
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Our Business / Our Property
requirements.evidence: Title deeds, lease deeds, rent agreements

requirements.requirement: Narrative disclosures must be written in the impersonal, formal register of an offer document rather than in the first person
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — presentation; exchange observation on promotional or conversational language
requirements.evidence: The issuer's own narrative answers
requirements.corpus_evidence: Every filing in the 14-document corpus is written impersonally about "the Company"; none uses the first person.

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Conversational or promotional language in an offer document draws an exchange observation on presentation.

requirements.requirement: Company-specific (internal) risk factors derived from the issuer's own business and operations
requirements.evidence: Derived from the issuer's business, financial and legal disclosures

requirements.requirement: Raw-material price volatility and supplier-concentration risk, where applicable
requirements.evidence: Procurement records, supplier schedule

applicability.reason: Not applicable: the issuer has indicated it does not operate manufacturing facilities, so raw-material price volatility is not a principal risk. Supplier concentration, where relevant to a services business, is captured under the general internal risk factors.

requirements.corpus_evidence: Appears in 64% of the 14-document corpus; the balance are services issuers with no manufacturing operations, which is why this requirement is sector-conditional.

requirements.requirement: Customer-concentration risk where a small number of customers account for a large revenue share
requirements.evidence: Derived from R2.3

requirements.requirement: Any outstanding litigation, tax demand or regulatory proceeding must be reflected as a risk factor
requirements.source: ICDR risk-disclosure principle; exchange return pattern (undisclosed proceedings)
requirements.evidence: Cross-check: Risk Factors vs Outstanding Litigation

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: A proceeding referenced anywhere in the issuer's records but absent from the Legal chapter is treated by the exchange as a material non-disclosure and routinely returns the draft.

requirements.requirement: External, industry and issue-related risk factors, including risks relating to the SME platform and limited liquidity
requirements.evidence: Industry analysis; issue structure

requirements.requirement: Restated audited financial statements for the last three financial years (Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement)
requirements.evidence: Restated financial statements certified by the peer-reviewed auditor

requirements.requirement: Statement of accounting ratios — basic and diluted EPS, Return on Net Worth, Net Asset Value per share
requirements.evidence: Derived from the restated financial statements

requirements.requirement: Reference to the peer-reviewed statutory auditor, the auditor's firm registration number and the examination report on the restated financials
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 246; exchange return pattern (missing auditor reference)
requirements.evidence: Auditor's examination report

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Omission of the peer-reviewed auditor reference and firm registration number is a standard exchange observation and blocks pre-check clearance.

requirements.requirement: The revenue series presented in the financial statements must be internally consistent with the latest-year revenue relied upon elsewhere in the document
requirements.evidence: Cross-check within Restated Financial Statements

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Internally inconsistent financial series are flagged automatically by the exchange pre-check.

requirements.requirement: Capitalisation statement showing borrowings and shareholders' funds before and after the issue
requirements.evidence: Derived from the restated financial statements and the issue size

sections.section_title: Capital Structure & Objects of the Issue

requirements.requirement: Pre-issue and post-issue shareholding pattern and the history of the equity share capital build-up
requirements.evidence: Register of members, share allotment records

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: A shareholding pattern that does not add back to the pre-issue paid-up capital is a routine exchange observation.

requirements.requirement: Issue size, number of equity shares offered, face value and the basis of the price band
requirements.evidence: Board and shareholder resolutions authorising the issue

requirements.requirement: Objects of the issue with a break-up of the proposed utilisation of net proceeds and the schedule of deployment
requirements.evidence: Board-approved deployment plan; quotations for capital expenditure

requirements.requirement: The aggregate of the stated objects must reconcile with the net proceeds of the issue
requirements.source: ICDR consistency principle; exchange return pattern (unreconciled figures)
requirements.evidence: Cross-check within Objects of the Issue

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Objects that do not aggregate to the stated net proceeds are flagged immediately by the exchange pre-check and are a leading cause of returned drafts.

requirements.requirement: Net proceeds must equal the gross issue size less the estimated issue-related expenses
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Objects of the Issue
requirements.evidence: Estimated issue expense schedule

consistency_check.label: Gross issue size less issue expenses vs stated net proceeds
consistency_check.exchange_pattern: The bridge from gross issue size to net proceeds must be arithmetically demonstrable.

requirements.requirement: Market maker reservation portion and the resulting net issue to the public
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 261 (market making for SME issues)
requirements.evidence: Market making agreement

requirements.requirement: Appointment of a monitoring agency for the deployment of issue proceeds, where the issue size excluding the offer for sale exceeds INR 50 crore
requirements.evidence: Monitoring agency appointment letter, or the board's basis for non-applicability

applicability.reason: Regulation 262(1) requires a monitoring agency only where the issue size, excluding any offer for sale, exceeds INR 50 crore. This issue is below that threshold, so no monitoring agency is required.

requirements.requirement: Basis of the estimated working-capital requirement funded from the net proceeds, with the assumptions and holding periods relied upon
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Objects of the Issue
requirements.evidence: Working-capital computation certified by the statutory auditor

requirements.requirement: Amount proposed to be deployed towards general corporate purposes, which must not exceed fifteen per cent of the amount being raised or INR 10 crore, whichever is less
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 230(2) (Chapter IX — SME), as substituted w.e.f. 8 March 2025
requirements.evidence: Objects break-up and gross issue size

consistency_check.label: General corporate purposes as a share of gross proceeds
consistency_check.exchange_pattern: General corporate purposes exceeding the prescribed ceiling is an arithmetic breach the exchange pre-check identifies immediately. The SME ceiling was tightened to the lower of 15% and INR 10 crore with effect from 8 March 2025, so a draft prepared on the earlier 25% basis will be returned.
consistency_check.subject: general corporate purposes
consistency_check.remediation: Reduce the general corporate purposes allocation to at most the ceiling shown, and identify the balance against a specific, described object. The ceiling is arithmetic and is checked directly by the exchange.

requirements.requirement: Break-up of the estimated issue-related expenses by category (fees of the lead manager, registrar, legal advisors, advertising, listing and statutory fees)
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Objects of the Issue
requirements.evidence: Estimated expense schedule agreed with the lead manager

requirements.requirement: The objects of the issue must not include repayment, directly or indirectly, of any loan taken from a promoter, a member of the promoter group or any related party
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 230(1)(h) (Chapter IX — SME), inserted w.e.f. 8 March 2025
requirements.evidence: Objects of the issue and the schedule of loans proposed to be repaid

consistency_check.label: Repayment of promoter or related-party borrowings from issue proceeds
consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Using issue proceeds to repay a promoter or related-party loan is expressly prohibited for SME issues and is a condition of eligibility, not a disclosure point. An object framed this way stops the issue rather than drawing a query.

requirements.requirement: Where the issue includes an offer for sale, that component must not exceed twenty per cent of the total issue size, and no selling shareholder may offer more than fifty per cent of their pre-issue holding on a fully diluted basis
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 230(1)(f) and (g) (Chapter IX — SME), inserted w.e.f. 8 March 2025
requirements.evidence: Issue structure showing the fresh issue and offer for sale components

applicability.reason: The issue is a fresh issue only, with no offer for sale component, so the Regulation 230(1)(f) and (g) limits do not apply.

consistency_check.subject: the offer for sale component
consistency_check.remediation: Reduce the offer for sale component to at most the ceiling shown, or increase the fresh issue so that the offer for sale falls within twenty per cent of the total issue size. This is a condition of eligibility for the issue, not a disclosure point.
consistency_check.label: Offer for sale as a share of the total issue size
consistency_check.exchange_pattern: The twenty per cent limit on the offer for sale component of an SME issue was introduced with effect from 8 March 2025 and is a condition of eligibility. A draft structured on the earlier basis does not draw a query, it fails the eligibility test.

requirements.requirement: Details of directors and key managerial personnel — name, designation, DIN, age, qualification and experience
requirements.evidence: Board records, DIN records, appointment letters

requirements.requirement: Related-party transactions, including transactions with promoter-group entities, and the amounts involved
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME); Ind AS 24; exchange return pattern (undisclosed related parties)
requirements.evidence: Related-party schedule in the audited financials

consistency_check.exchange_pattern: Undisclosed related-party dealings are one of the three most common reasons an SME draft is returned by the exchange.

requirements.requirement: Outstanding litigation and material developments against the company, its directors, promoters and group companies
requirements.evidence: Legal counsel certificate; case records; tax demand notices

requirements.requirement: Group companies, their basic particulars and the nature of the relationship
requirements.evidence: Group structure chart; MCA filings

requirements.requirement: Corporate governance — board composition, independent directors, and constitution of the Audit, Nomination & Remuneration and Stakeholders Relationship Committees
requirements.evidence: Board and committee constitution resolutions

requirements.requirement: Remuneration paid to directors and key managerial personnel
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME); Companies Act 2013 s.197
requirements.evidence: Remuneration records; audited financials

requirements.requirement: Particulars of the issuer's subsidiaries, if any, with the nature of the holding and their financial position — or an express statement that the issuer has none
requirements.evidence: Shareholding records; MCA filings of each subsidiary

requirements.requirement: Cover page particulars — 'Draft Red Herring Prospectus' label, issue type (fixed price / book built), face value, price band, and the listing platform
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) Part A — cover page
requirements.evidence: Issue structure decisions; exchange in-principle application

requirements.requirement: Issuer's absolute responsibility statement and the lead manager's responsibility statement
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) Part A — cover page
requirements.evidence: Signed by the board and the lead manager

requirements.requirement: General risk statement and the SME platform eligibility / listing statement
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) Part A; ICDR Chapter IX eligibility
requirements.evidence: Standard statement; exchange eligibility confirmation

requirements.requirement: Definitions and abbreviations, including issue-related, company-related and industry terms
requirements.evidence: Standard glossary merged with issuer-specific terms

requirements.requirement: Presentation of financial, industry and market data — currency of presentation, financial year convention, rounding and the sourcing of third-party industry data
requirements.evidence: Standard statement

requirements.requirement: Forward-looking statements caution and the issuer's undertaking on material developments
requirements.evidence: Standard statement

requirements.requirement: Summary of the offer document — business, industry, promoters, issue size, objects, restated financials, litigation, related-party transactions and contingent liabilities, presented together at the front of the document
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Summary of the Offer Document
requirements.evidence: Derived from the corresponding detailed chapters
requirements.corpus_evidence: Required by Schedule VI; the first chapter an exchange reviewer reads.

sections.section_title: The Issue, Terms and Issue Procedure

requirements.requirement: The Issue table — fresh issue and/or offer for sale, number of equity shares, face value and issue size
requirements.evidence: Board and shareholder resolutions

requirements.requirement: Issue structure — allocation between retail individual investors and other-than-retail investors, and the market maker portion
requirements.evidence: Issue structure agreed with the lead manager

requirements.requirement: Terms of the issue — ranking of equity shares, mode of payment, rights of holders, minimum application size and lot
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Terms of the Issue
requirements.evidence: Standard terms merged with the issue's lot size

requirements.requirement: Issue procedure — ASBA and UPI mechanism, bidding process, basis of allotment and refund timelines
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME); SEBI ASBA/UPI circulars
requirements.evidence: Standard procedure text

requirements.requirement: Underwriting and market making arrangements, including the underwriter's obligations
requirements.evidence: Underwriting agreement; market making agreement

requirements.requirement: Qualitative factors supporting the issue price
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price
requirements.evidence: Derived from competitive strengths

requirements.requirement: Quantitative factors — basic and diluted EPS, price-to-earnings ratio at the price band, Return on Net Worth and Net Asset Value per share
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price
requirements.evidence: Derived from the restated financial statements

requirements.requirement: Comparison with listed industry peers, or an express statement that no directly comparable listed peer exists
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price
requirements.evidence: Peer set with sources; exchange filings of peers

requirements.requirement: Key performance indicators of the issuer's business, disclosed for each restated period, certified and approved by the audit committee
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price; SEBI KPI disclosure requirements
requirements.evidence: KPI schedule approved by the audit committee and certified by the statutory auditor

requirements.requirement: Weighted average cost of acquisition of equity shares by the promoters and selling shareholders, compared against the issue price
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price; SEBI WACA disclosure requirements
requirements.evidence: Share acquisition history certified by the statutory auditor

requirements.requirement: Weighted average earnings per share and return on net worth across the restated periods, weighted by the respective period weights
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Basis for Issue Price
requirements.evidence: Derived from the restated financial statements

requirements.requirement: Management's discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations, with year-on-year movement explained
requirements.evidence: Restated financials and management commentary

requirements.requirement: Significant factors affecting the results of operations and any known trends or uncertainties
requirements.evidence: Management commentary

requirements.requirement: Financial indebtedness — secured and unsecured borrowings, principal lenders, security created and material terms
requirements.evidence: Sanction letters; charge registers; lender certificates

requirements.requirement: Government and other statutory approvals held and applied for, and approvals still required
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Government and Other Approvals
requirements.evidence: Licences, consents, registrations

requirements.requirement: Key regulations and policies applicable to the issuer's business
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Key Regulations and Policies
requirements.evidence: Sector regulation mapping

requirements.requirement: Other regulatory and statutory disclosures — SEBI disclaimer, exchange disclaimer, consents, expert opinions, previous public issues and listing particulars
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Other Regulatory and Statutory Disclosures
requirements.evidence: Standard clauses with issuer particulars merged

requirements.requirement: Price information of past issues handled by the lead manager, and the lead manager's track record
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI — Other Regulatory and Statutory Disclosures
requirements.evidence: Track record furnished by the lead manager

requirements.requirement: Promoter particulars — name, age, qualification, experience, and shareholding in the issuer
requirements.evidence: Promoter declarations; register of members

requirements.requirement: Minimum promoter contribution and the lock-in applicable to promoter and pre-issue capital
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 236, 238 (SME promoter contribution and lock-in)
requirements.evidence: Lock-in undertaking; depository confirmation

requirements.requirement: Confirmation that the issuer, its promoters, promoter group, directors and selling shareholders are not debarred from accessing the capital markets, and that none is a wilful defaulter, a fraudulent borrower or a fugitive economic offender
requirements.source: ICDR Reg 228 (Chapter IX — entities not eligible to make an initial public offer)
requirements.evidence: Promoter and director declarations verified in due diligence

requirements.requirement: Dividend policy and the dividend declared, if any, in the preceding financial years
requirements.evidence: Board-approved dividend policy; dividend records

requirements.requirement: Statement of special tax benefits available to the company and its shareholders, certified by the statutory auditor
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME) — Statement of Special Tax Benefits
requirements.evidence: Auditor's tax benefits certificate

requirements.requirement: Main provisions of the Articles of Association
requirements.evidence: Articles of Association

requirements.requirement: Material contracts and documents available for inspection
requirements.evidence: Contract register; issue agreements

requirements.requirement: Declaration by the directors and the Company Secretary confirming compliance with the Companies Act, the SEBI Act and the ICDR Regulations, and that no statement made is contrary to those provisions
requirements.evidence: Signed declaration page

requirements.requirement: Restrictions on foreign ownership of Indian securities under FEMA and the consolidated FDI policy
requirements.source: ICDR Sch VI (SME); FEMA (Non-debt Instruments) Rules
requirements.evidence: Standard clause
